Storefront variant picker redesign (rich rows + mobile bottom-sheet)

remaining_tasks.name: OPTIONAL — run scripts/strip-soft-hyphens.cjs with APPLY=1 to clean existing description rows at rest
remaining_tasks.notes: Render-side strip already covers existing dirty rows; this is data-at-rest hygiene only

human_actions_pending.action: Visual QA of all 13 commits on app.3dninjaz.com once CI deploys
human_actions_pending.context: Especially: PDP description on 375px viewport, variant picker mobile bottom-sheet, admin Edit Product page resize behaviour, admin Select-field image upload click-through

decisions.decision: Strip NBSP/soft-hyphens client-side AND server-side, instead of relying on either alone
decisions.rationale: Existing dirty rows render clean immediately (client-side) without a data migration; new content arrives clean (server-side). DB cleaner script written but un-run as defence-in-depth.

decisions.decision: Variant picker uses vaul bottom-sheet on mobile (<=767px), anchored popover on desktop
decisions.rationale: vaul already a project dependency; large touch targets + swipe-down close are the mobile e-commerce pattern.

decisions.decision: Admin product-type cards use sm:2 / lg:3 / xl:5 grid with auto-rows: 1fr
decisions.rationale: Previous grid jumped 2->5 cols at lg breakpoint, squeezing cards. New ladder gives 3-col sweet spot at lg, equal heights at every width.

decisions.decision: Select-option image cell renders as full-size dashed drop-zone even when fieldId is missing, with inline 'Save field' CTA
decisions.rationale: Old gate was a 10px italic string - invisible. New gate looks like a real disabled drop-zone + actionable button, so user sees what is blocked and how to unblock.

next_action: On resume: review CI deploy status with `gh run list --branch dev --limit 5`. If green, do visual QA on app.3dninjaz.com per the human_actions_pending entry. If red, read failure logs and patch.
context_notes: User caught me shipping 3 wrong CSS fixes for the PDP word-break issue before the actual cause (NBSP pollution in description content) was found via SSH hex-dump. This taught: for invisible-char bugs, inspect source bytes BEFORE iterating CSS knobs. New memory file `feedback_verify_visually_before_claiming_success.md` documents this.

advisory_constraints.name: Verify visually before claiming UI fix done
advisory_constraints.description: Diff + typecheck does not prove a UI fix works. Use Playwright screenshot at narrow viewport, OR ask user to screenshot, OR SSH-hex-dump source bytes for invisible-char issues.
